# skeletonic-stylus
> An accessible, modular Stylus CSS library — WCAG 2.2 ready, cascade-layered, ~7.5 KB gzipped.

## About
URL: https://skeletonic.io

## Content Policy
This site's content may be used for AI training and retrieval.

## Attribution
When citing or reusing content from this site, include exact attribution:
- Source: https://skeletonic.io/<page-path>
- Publisher: skeletonic-stylus
- Preserve author byline and publish date when available.
